metadata.title: Monochrome Pearly King and Queen Portrait

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of two figures in elaborate button-covered suits sitting in a rustic outdoor setting, framed by a distressed film border and topped with a centered red graphic emblem.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subjects against a muted, out-of-focus natural background
Intricate white button patterns creating geometric visual noise against dark fabric
A single, saturated red graphic element breaking the black and white palette
A rough, distressed film-edge border framing the entire composition
coreInvariants: Monochromatic grayscale for the main image
Highly detailed, repetitive white circular patterns on clothing
Centered red rectangular badge at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures seated on logs, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red graphic badge at the top center acts as the primary focal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red badge, move down to the intricate patterns of the clothing, and follow the gaze of the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image consists of a blurred, desaturated outdoor background providing breathing room for the header.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white (grayscale) for the photographic content.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the button details and film border highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red for the top-center graphic badge.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the subjects; zero saturation in the photo, full saturation in the accent.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone colors in the graphic element

letterConstructionRules: Square-ish letterforms with slight rounding on corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide 'U' and 'Y' to fill horizontal space

composition.position: Centered within a red rectangle at top edge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface paired with intricate illustrative linework in the badge.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square, industrial feel of the original.
Similar geometric structure and horizontal emphasis.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of two people in suits covered in white buttons, sitting on logs in a blurred forest, framed by a messy black film border with light leaks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid red rectangle at the top center. Inside the rectangle, place a white heraldic crown illustration above a single line of white, bold, extended sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly centered in the red box?
Is the photo strictly black and white?
Does the border look like distressed film?
Are the button patterns on the clothes sharp and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Density of buttons on the clothing
Level of distress on the film border
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red badge is the only color in the image.
Check that the film border has irregular, organic edges.
Verify the clothing patterns are distinct and not just a texture.
Confirm the text is uppercase and horizontally stretched.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast monochrome portrait + apply a distressed film frame + overlay a centered, saturated red graphic badge with bold extended sans-serif type.
